title: Flow Hive Super Weight Jump Watch
dataSources: Hive metrics (`flowhive:reading`), egg counter events (`eggcounter:event`), goat RFID visits (`goattag:scan`), goat watering and feed logs (`goatcare:event`), and compost readings (`compost:reading`).
app: Smallholding and backyard telemetry from Flow Hive scales, chicken coop counters, RFID goat tags, compost thermometers, and camera-driven chore logs sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=flowhive:reading
| search weight_delta_kg=*
| bin _time span=1d
| stats avg(weight_delta_kg) as avg_weight_delta_kg max(weight_delta_kg) as max_weight_delta_kg by _time hive_id
| sort - _time
description: Tracks Flow Hive super-weight change over time and breaks it out by hive.
value: Weight jumps help you spot nectar surges, harvest windows, or unexpected disturbances without opening the hive.
implementation: Send Flow Hive super-weight change events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of Flow Hive super-weight change by hive.
grandmaExplanation: It records how Flow Hive super-weight change changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
